row:
OUR MAIN MISSION IS SIMPLE; TO FIND LOVING HOMES FOR UNWANTED, HOMELESS OR NEGLECTED ANIMALS IN RICHMOND UPON THAMES AND SURROUNDING AREAS. BUT WHAT WE DO IS SO MUCH MORE THAN THAT.

Whether it's rescuing animals from cruelty or taking in the hundreds of abandoned ones, we foster and give them the medical and specialist attention they need, including neutering. We look after them until we are able to find approved owners who adopt them into loving, happy homes. And we do this as a non-profit charity run by volunteers and we're funded purely by donations.

As part of our mission, we offer advice, information and actively raise public awareness about animal welfare. In particular, animal neutering: it's the only way to stop the cycle of unwanted animals.
